audit: Homepage advertised 42 tools but setup and docs connected to the 13-tool core profile.
The picker fixed its palette so theme changes did not reach the control.
Theme comparison controls were hidden inside a large popover.

direction.product: Eidova supplies design systems, guidance and reviews for coding agents.
direction.world: Product manuals and usable developer tools.
direction.moments: The actual page changes as visitors slide between themes.
direction.signature: A named theme above a compact live slider.

limits: Local Edge/Chromium review; no human screen-reader walkthrough.

verification.themeChecks: 31 themes in both appearances at 390, 1440 and 1728; contrast, inheritance, pointer/keyboard slider input, search, persistence/history, isolated previews, storage failure, catalog outage, Axe and 200% text pass
verification.routeChecks: 36 route states, zero Axe violations and zero browser errors; responsive and enlarged-text reflow, six default connection formats, profile switching, Docs URL and system/saved/URL appearance pass
verification.clipboard: All six clients copy the exact full endpoint; Docs copies the full Codex command
verification.protocol: Live tools/list returns 42 at /mcp and 13 at /mcp/core. Local Codex Eidova configuration now uses /mcp.
verification.manifest: Registry metadata schema and full-profile assertions pass
verification.publication: Reviewed source ready for production publication; deployment evidence recorded separately.
